name: CSTR VCTK Corpus
description: A corpus of English speech recordings from 110 speakers with diverse accents, recorded for research in speech synthesis and speaker recognition.
citation: Yamagishi, J., Veaux, C., and MacDonald, K. (2019). CSTR VCTK Corpus: English Multi-speaker Corpus for CSTR Voice Cloning Toolkit. https://doi.org/10.7488/ds/2645
